caption: Kerk, Niehove
composition: Long brick church with a ridge turret on the terp, houses in a ring · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the terp at Niehove the brick church sits in the middle, a long hall with a small ridge turret, and farmhouses follow the ring road. It is overcast, about 9.6°C. The circular moat was filled long ago and is not shown. The church, used as a visitor centre by day, is closed at this hour.
